1.Title: {0}h Voyage: Setting Sail
1.Desc: As the ship sets sail for the open seas, guild members crowd onto the deck, eagerly discussing their upcoming adventures in foreign lands.

2.Title: {0}h Voyage: Fishing the Calm Seas
2.Desc: The sea is calm and clear today, as guild members sit beside the ship's railing, fishing and relaxing.

3.Title: {0}h Voyage: Land Ho!
3.Desc: Through a spyglass, one member spots a new land in the distance! Enroll now and gather in {0} for landfall!

4.Desc: As the sun sinks below the distant horizon, the navigator shifts course and sails onward.

5.Desc: As dusk falls, the night watch takes their post atop the crow's nest, spotting a strange outline in the distance.

6.Desc: The seas suddenly grow rough, but the crew works together to steady the ship, charting a course toward their destination.

7.Title: {0}h Voyage: Coastal Observations
7.Desc: As the outline of the land mass becomes clearer, the crew begin discussing their landing operation.

8.Title: {0}h Voyage: Battle-Ready
8.Desc: The ship's supplies and flags are fully prepared, and the crew eagerly await their entry to the battlefield!

9.Title: {0}h Voyage: Daybreak Landfall
9.Desc: The ship approaches the coast, its lanterns still shining as the crew review their finalized deployment plan.

10.Title: {0}h Voyage: Expedition Begins
10.Desc: The Expedition has begun! All members rally immediately, complete your landing and deployment—and fight for the glory of your guild!
